title: CVE-2024-27834 added to CISA KEV (exploited in the wild)
summary_en: Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.
lines: Apple Multiple Products: Apple Multiple Products Improper Authentication Vulnerability

Apple iOS, iPadOS, macOS, Safari, tvOS and watchOS 10.5 contain an improper authentication vulnerability which could allow an attacker with arbitrary read and write capability to bypass pointer authentication.
